name: Convex-Geometry Ideals Are Dismantlable Ample
scope: Finite nonempty lower ideals of convex geometries, up to signed-coordinate equivalence.
statement: Every lower ideal of a finite convex geometry is a conditional antimatroid and therefore admits a corner peeling.
proof: A lower ideal remains intersection closed. The extremal generators of each member in the ambient convex geometry lie in the ideal together with every lower set needed for their deletion, giving the conditional-antimatroid property; such systems are corner peelable.
